versions.changelog:
vibelock-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release of the VibeLock skill for AI developer security and commercialization.
- Pure dialogue-guided workflow; no local dependencies required.
- Covers code encryption, obfuscation, packaging, licensing, anti-crack, and platform integration for all languages and architectures.
- Provides four protection levels (A/B/C/D), with the highest being open-source and free.
- Automatically activates when related security or packaging keywords are mentioned.
